email_body:
Dear Scrambly Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Account Manager role. Your reward-powered app discovery platform and bootstrapped, 250%+ YoY growth immediately caught my attention. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I bring a blend of analytical skills and technical understanding that fits your performance-first approach.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using data from Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to optimize campaigns. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring technical setups run smoothly. My freelance work involves hands-on campaign tracking and optimization, and I'm comfortable with numbers and data-driven decisions. While I haven't worked directly with MMPs like AppsFlyer or Adjust, I have a strong foundation in digital marketing and a proven ability to learn quickly. I'm eager to apply my skills to manage advertiser relationships, optimize multi-reward campaigns, and contribute to Scrambly's growth.

I'm excited about the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, remote environment where ideas turn into impact quickly. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Scrambly Team,

I am excited to apply for the Account Manager position at Scrambly. Your mission to build a reward-powered alternative to traditional app stores, combined with your impressive bootstrapped growth, resonates with my own passion for performance-driven digital marketing. I am confident that my analytical mindset, technical background, and client-facing experience make me a strong fit for this role.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance and optimize campaigns. I collaborate with team members to ensure client sites—ranging from consultancy to e-commerce—achieve their organic growth targets. This experience has honed my ability to analyze data sets, identify opportunities, and communicate effectively with stakeholders. Additionally, my freelance work involves building and optimizing websites, where I implement technical SEO audits and structured data to improve search visibility. I have also developed a solid understanding of campaign tracking through hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Google Ads.

While I have not yet worked directly with MMPs like AppsFlyer or Adjust, I have a strong foundation in digital marketing and a proven ability to quickly learn new tools and concepts. My entrepreneurial mindset and proactive work style have allowed me to take ownership of projects and deliver measurable results. I am eager to apply my skills to manage advertiser relationships, optimize multi-reward campaigns, and contribute to Scrambly's continued success.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where collaboration and innovation drive impact. I am excited about the opportunity to learn from your team and to help advertisers achieve their KPIs through data-driven strategies. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Scrambly's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital marketing experience with SEO, content, and web development, using data from Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to optimize campaigns.
• Client-facing roles at Episto, managing SEO and content for multiple client websites, ensuring campaign success and identifying growth opportunities.
• Technical proficiency in WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python automation, enabling smooth campaign setups and troubleshooting.
• Analytical skills demonstrated through keyword research, technical SEO audits, and performance reporting, with a focus on measurable results.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with freelance experience building and optimizing websites, showing proactive problem-solving and continuous learning.
